capabilities: Batch move, rename, delete, and merge files from search, clipboard, current file, Dataview, or Bases sources
Add, modify, delete, and rename frontmatter properties across many files
Create files from unresolved links and copy Dataview/Bases result links
Sync file links, content, or selection to flomo and batch-add files, text, or tasks to a canvas
Undo batch operations from automatic backup snapshots with per-file revert
extras: AI features are marked experimental and disabled by default; the backup folder (.file-cooker/backups) is created inside the vault and can be excluded from search and graph; Canvas operations and flomo sync are not covered by backup/undo; Obsidian >= 1.12.3 required since v2.0.0; UI supports Chinese and English.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply one operation (move, rename, property edit, delete, merge) to a whole set of files gathered from different sources in a single confirmed step.

relations.evidence: Requires the Dataview plugin; DataviewJS supported since v1.7.1
no MetaEdit plugin needed (built-in since v1.8.0)
Sync to flomo: sync file links, file content, or current selection (requires flomoAPI)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, Ollama) for AI features

summary: Batch file operations plugin that moves, renames, edits properties, deletes, or merges many files selected from search, clipboard, Dataview, or Bases results.
